details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:1775-1811 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: record_lessons_learned was removed while unchanged scripts still import it, so those workflows now fail to import ai_memory_lib.
  WHY: review_consolidate.sh, review_rb_judge.sh, review_apply_fixes.sh, and orchestrate_poll_process.sh still import the symbol, so their Python heredocs will raise ImportError at runtime.
- scripts/ai_memory.py:906-2417 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: the documented review/prune/search/export CLI subcommands were removed.
  WHY: operator workflows and automation that invoke those subcommands now get argparse "invalid choice" errors instead of the expected behavior.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:17-210 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: the --allowlist-file CLI path and explicit allowlist support were removed.
  WHY: external callers passing --allowlist-file will now fail argparse parsing, breaking the explicit allowlist workflow.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:143-155 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: the recursive globstar matcher was replaced with plain fnmatchcase, so `**` patterns no longer match nested paths correctly.
  WHY: reviewers disagreed on severity (major vs blocker), but all agreed recursive allowlist entries like `scripts/**/*.py` stop matching as intended.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:966-1155 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: path metadata containing `=` can be truncated by the simple `IFS='=' read` parsing.
  WHY: a legitimate unsupported path with `=` in its name would be logged incorrectly, making the REVIEW_TIER metadata misleading.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:955-1069 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: values written into GITHUB_ENV are not escaped for future scope/path strings with shell metacharacters.
  WHY: current directory names are safe, but the env-file write is fragile if future scope values contain `$`, backticks, or similar characters.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:1240-1240 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `|| true` masks a non-zero result from resolve_review_tier_active_models.
  WHY: current branches are covered, but the swallowed failure would hide an inconsistent state if new failure paths are added later.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:418-421 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: the ai:scope label post-commit verifier block was removed.
  WHY: when SCOPE_LOCK_LABEL_ENABLED=true, out-of-scope changes will no longer be detected after commit, breaking the scope-lock contract.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:389-697 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: the diagnose JSON contract no longer includes evidence_trace and hypothesis.
  WHY: downstream issue generation and fix-up flows lose the evidence trail and supported hypothesis used for debugging implementation failures.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:59-108 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: the ai:retro, ai:security-audit, and ai:security label definitions were removed.
  WHY: workflows that apply those labels lose their configured metadata, breaking the security-audit and retro tracker semantics.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:24-789 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: the persona-prefix system for prompt rendering was removed.
  WHY: prompt outputs for clarify/plan/implement/validate/judge lose their role-specific identity prefixes, changing model behavior.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:219-243 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: the schema copy logic no longer backfills workflow-source schemas into repos that already have their own schemas directory.
  WHY: consumer repos can miss newly added workflow schema files, causing missing-schema validation failures.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:1743-2093 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: the _is_prune_marked guard was removed from promote_candidates and retrieve_memory_context.
  WHY: prune-marked records can now be promoted or surfaced in memory context, contradicting operator intent and exposing stale information.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:2295-2328 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: compact_memory no longer uses prune_marked_at to archive/delete records.
  WHY: prune-marked candidates can accumulate indefinitely because only created_at and a narrower status set now drive deletion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
